content:
- Committed the boundary cleanup plus Ralph bookkeeping as 651832d and pushed master to origin successfully.
- Ran bash .ralph/task_switch.sh; it completed task summary updates and sent the email notification, but the known bug recurred: rm reported missing .ralph/current_task.txt.
- Next context only needs to react if someone wants to fix task_switch.sh itself; the bug is already logged in .ralph/tasks/bugs/task-switch-missing-current-task-file.md.

- Started task by reading Ralph progress; no prior progress content was returned.
- Loaded the improve-code-boundaries skill and listed src/tests files.
- Next: inspect found_smells and identify one concrete boundary smell to flatten.

- Confirmed repo has existing Ralph task-tracking changes only; no code changes yet.
- Found a likely boundary smell in src/cli/connect.rs: CLI layer constructs command DTOs directly instead of delegating to command boundary.
- Next: inspect src/command/mod.rs and nearby CLI modules to see whether the DTO/projection construction can be centralized and helper duplication removed.

- Moved authoritative primary lookup from src/command/mod.rs into src/api/mod.rs as a shared NodeState boundary.
- Updated CLI command modules and HA integration test support to call the shared helper instead of duplicating publication-state interpretation.
- Next: remove any unused imports, format, then run make lint and make test.

- Ran make lint; clippy failed with a compile error in src/command/mod.rs after the boundary move.
- The remaining use was MemberId::as_str in table rendering; import had been removed as part of the refactor.
- Next: replace that reference with a closure over the borrowed member id, rerun make lint, then make test.

- make test failed with one HA invariant test: one_primary_and_two_replicas_are_determined_healthy timed out waiting for shared counter >= 3; observed 0.
- This looks unrelated to the authoritative-primary boundary refactor, but repo policy says to treat spotted bugs as real and log them.
- Next: use add-bug skill, inspect the failing test and decide whether to fix the flake or rerun to confirm scope before proceeding to commit/push.

- Added Ralph bug task for the flaky write-convergence healthy invariant stall seen during make test.
- Reran the failing nextest case in isolation and it passed, which points to a pre-existing flaky test rather than a deterministic regression from the authority-helper refactor.
- Next: rerun the full make test target; if it passes, finish commit/push/task switch with the bug task included.

- Completed boundary refactor by moving authoritative primary lookup to src/api/mod.rs and deleting duplicated publication-state matches from command/CLI/test support.
- make lint passed; make test initially hit a flaky HA write-convergence invariant, which I logged as .ralph/tasks/bugs/bug-write-convergence-healthy-invariant-counter-stalls.md, then make test passed on rerun.
- Next for future context windows: investigate and deflake the recorded write-convergence invariant plus the known leaky reload-certificates tests.
